summary: Layer 2B maps the candidate chunk to ticker-level public-market relationships inside the Politics theme, focused on policy-created demand signals and regulation-created bottlenecks in the defense industrial base, solid-rocket-motor inputs, strategic minerals, rare-earth qualification, and sub-tier defense electronics/components. Reference leaders are intentionally not the focus; the main research lane remains underfollowed small/mid-cap or niche public suppliers. The strongest ticker relationship in this chunk is NEU via AMPAC ammonium perchlorate exposure because it maps directly to solid-rocket-motor input constraints while remaining hidden inside a petroleum-additives screen. KRMN and PKE map to missile/rocket-motor component and materials nodes but require primary-source validation of program mix, sole-source or qualification status, and capacity constraints. MP, NEO.TO, and LYC.AX map to the rare-earth/magnet compliance chain, where the key issue is not headline mine capacity but qualified non-Chinese feedstock, separation, and magnet/material qualification. UAMY is a speculative_shadow strategic-minerals candidate with high policy relevance but elevated micro/small-cap execution, liquidity, and contract-verification risk. MRCY and DCO are broader sub-tier defense supplier hypotheses where the next layer must prove actual bottleneck status rather than generic defense exposure.
